selection: one deterministic opposite-label pair per exactly identical instantaneous observation, with same world topology, disjoint episodes, nonzero source weight for TRAIN, and maximum minimum age since last newly delivered event

contract.format: Full ordered v54 source episodes are retained, never individual shuffled critical examples.
contract.train: TRAIN_focus_stream.jsonl is an additional curriculum subset, not a replacement for v54 TRAIN. Model input is steps[].input only. steps[].focus_loss_weight upweights matched memory decisions; original weight=0 stays masked.
contract.dev: DEV_EVALUATOR_ONLY_focus_stream.jsonl is for development evaluation only, never optimization.
contract.heldout: HELDOUT_EVALUATOR_ONLY_focus_stream.jsonl is sealed evaluation; do not tune or train on it.
contract.pairs: *_pairs_EVALUATOR_ONLY.jsonl contain action labels and decisive indices. NEVER enter them into the model prompt, feature stream or recurrent state.
contract.metrics: Evaluate both members of each pair; report pair-both-correct as primary, per-choice balanced accuracy, 8+-step and 16+-step memory-age tiers, category subgroups and full-episode terminal success separately.
contract.deployment: Offline teacher-forced labels do not prove closed-loop autonomy; validate using synthetic host first and CyberSand-native ABI only in an independently authorized read/evaluation process.
contract.leakage: Never pool related world identities across splits or corpus versions. Do not leak selected pair metadata or evaluator labels.

limitations: Selection is from existing v54/v53 synthetic episodes, not new host-executed scenarios
Hardness is defined by instantaneous observation collisions; a full symbolic event-memory controller could still solve it
Some opposite navigation labels may be tie-related; evaluate action-regret/goal completion in a real host before treating as causal
Prelude receipts are script-generated; age measured only since latest *streamed* event, not prelude host time
No LFM/Sprocket weight changes or neural CPU latency/RSS; no native CyberSand execution
No immutable Actions release included by this generator
